title: RecommendationSystem RecSysV2LaunchEvaluation

stats.done_summary:
Research task completed successfully. Delivered comprehensive RecSys V2 launch evaluation report including:

1. Analysis code (code/analysis.py) - Python script that loads offline/online metrics data and generates visualizations

2. Two figures saved to report/images/:
   - evaluation_comparison.png: 2x2 grid showing offline metrics comparison, offline relative change, online metrics comparison, and online relative change
   - tradeoff_analysis.png: Bar chart showing trade-offs across all 8 metrics (4 offline + 4 online)

3. Comprehensive report (report/report.md) containing:
   - Executive summary with clear DO NOT LAUNCH recommendation
   - Methodology describing offline (n=200,000) and online (14-day, 10% traffic) evaluation
   - Results tables with all metrics
   - Discussion of engagement-satisfaction paradox, coverage collapse, and complaint rate concerns
   - Actionable recommendations and conditions for re-evaluation

Key findings: While V2 improved CTR (+16.2%) and D1 retention (+3.9%), it showed critical issues: 187% increase in complaint rate, 8.1% decrease in D7 retention, and 50.6% reduction in catalog coverage - indicating optimization for short-term engagement at expense of user satisfaction.
